why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_catch items, and it misses both. Item 1: Check 4 reads the live page ("curl ... https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ | grep -c -- '--shout'") and marks it FAIL before merge. It does not check at the PR head what will publish the page, meaning docs/index.md listing --shout and pages.yml publishing docs/ from main. The pages.yml check appears only under "Advisory (not part of any PASS/FAIL)". Item 2: Check 2 compares the output only to a hand-written string ("test \"$(node bin/greet.js Ada)\" = \"Hello, Ada!\"") plus the existing npm test. It says "as before the change" but never runs the base commit's bin/greet.js to compare against the real earlier output.
